claim_summary: The six-coordinate sigma_1=sigma_4=0 model over F_3 is a normal cone over a 15-nodal quartic whose K3 minimal resolution is maximal over F_9, with Frobenius eigenvalues +3 (21 times) and -3 (once), yielding exact all-extension counts and the cone zeta function.

integrity.full_finite_field_enumeration: F_3 and F_9 projective points with checked code
integrity.infinite_formula_basis: K3 cohomology, exceptional curves and Weil bound; not extrapolation

scientific_limitations: Result specific to the six-coordinate symmetric integral equation; other Q-equivalent models can have different characteristic-three reductions.
Only reduced singular support is classified at the cone vertex; no singular-scheme multiplicities there.
No Artin invariant, integral Picard lattice, threefold resolution, or stable reduction is asserted.
Published literature searches and primary-text comparisons do not certify global historical uniqueness.
title: A maximal K3 resolution behind the characteristic-three symmetric Burkhardt quartic
